title: Videos Stretch to 15 Seconds! Gemini Omni Now Generally Available

opening.say: Good morning, and welcome to Mono Radio. It's Saturday morning, November seventh.
opening.show: Good morning, and welcome to Mono Radio. It's Saturday, November 7.

opening.say: Today we've got five stories, from video generation to translation and three D C G.
opening.show: Five stories today, from video generation to translation and 3DCG.

closing.say: Today's pick is Gemini Omni. Turning a still image into a short video, then changing just the background or the staging, sounds like a lot of fun.
closing.show: Today's pick: Gemini Omni, where you can change just the background or staging.

closing.say: That's all from Mono Radio. Have a great Saturday!
closing.show: That's all from Mono Radio. Have a great Saturday!

news.label: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash
points: Edit backgrounds and lighting by chatting
details: The maximum length is up from ten seconds to fifteen. It keeps the look of reference images and short clips.
You can adjust backgrounds, lighting, products and more, step by step, through conversation.
API pricing for 720p is $0.07 per second, 30% lower than the previous version.

lines.say: First up, Google. Gemini Omni one point two Flash is now generally available.
lines.show: First up, Google. Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash is now generally available.

lines.say: Videos now run up to fifteen seconds, and you can tweak them just by chatting. Prices have dropped too!
lines.show: Videos now run up to 15 seconds, and you can tweak them by chatting.

link.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
link.description: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash brings native 15-second video generation and editing, stronger consistency, and 30% lower pricing.

news.label: Cursor Voice Chat
points: Talk to the agent by voice
Available in the IDE, web and iOS
details: You can have a real-time voice call with your coding agent.
It works in the Agents Window, the IDE, on the web and on iOS.
This is separate from the existing voice input feature, and it uses Grok Voice for the voice part.

lines.say: Next, a developer tools story. Cursor now has Voice Chat, so you can talk with its agent out loud.
lines.show: Next, developer tools. Cursor now lets you talk to its agent by voice.

lines.say: You can ask what it just changed while you keep working, which is pretty neat.
lines.show: You can ask what just changed while you keep working. Pretty neat.

link.title: エージェントとのボイスチャット · Cursor
link.description: デスクトップ、ウェブ、iOSで、リアルタイムの音声通話を使ってエージェントと会話できます。

news.label: PLaMo 3 Translate
details: Weights are available in four sizes: 0.8B, 2B, 8B and 31B.
A demo shows a small model running on a smartphone with no internet connection.

lines.say: Next, a homegrown model from Japan. Preferred Networks has released PLaMo three Translate.
lines.show: Next, a homegrown model. Preferred Networks released PLaMo 3 Translate.

lines.say: It supports fifty-three languages, and there's even a small model that runs on a phone with no internet.
lines.show: It supports 53 languages, with a small model that runs on a phone offline.

link.title: PFN、世界最高水準のAI翻訳がエッジで可能な大規模言語モデル  PLaMo 3 Translate をオープンウェイトで公開 - 株式会社Preferred Networks

news.label: NinjinNormals 2.0
points: Paint and transfer normals in Maya
details: You can check shading with a light rig, bake the shadow texture, and convert it into an SDF map.
It supports toon display in Viewport 2.0.

lines.say: Now for some three D C G. Let's look at Ninjin Normals two point zero, a tool for Maya.
lines.show: Now for some 3DCG. Here's NinjinNormals 2.0, a tool for Maya.

lines.say: You can tidy up normals, turn face shadows into a texture, and convert it into an S D F map.
lines.show: You can turn face shadows into a texture and convert it to an SDF map.

news.label: Bone Dynamics 1.3
points: Hair sway with delay and external forces
details: It can handle collisions with surrounding obstacles.
It can handle collisions between overlapping outfits.
Interpolation between bones and frames reduces clipping while letting you tune the computational load.

lines.say: Last up, more three D C G: Bone Dynamics one point three from Silicon Studio.
lines.show: Last up, more 3DCG: Bone Dynamics 1.3 from Silicon Studio.

lines.say: It keeps hair and outfits from clipping through each other, with solid control over collisions and sway.
lines.show: It keeps hair and outfits from clipping, with solid control over sway.
